readme_row: | `Causal.NotchedPlane` | — | ETT programme, layer 1 (T-abs-plain-not-open): the notched plane `ℝ² ∖ I⁺(0) = {u ≤ 0 ∨ v ≤ 0}` in null coordinates (a closed subspace, Hausdorff and second countable), with Minkowski's polygonal causality inside it (`≤_U`, `≪_U` by chains of future causal, timelike segments in `U`; a causal segment ending in `M` stays in `M`), is causally arc-connected, absolutely minimal on every open set for every cover, causally plain, push-up, globally hyperbolic, strongly causal, with a time function, causally open in the future; not causally open in the past (`J⁻_M` of a box about `(0, 1)`), nor locally at the corner, no chronal neighbours, not tarentin (the corner is in no open diamond); its time reversal likewise, not causally open in the future nor locally (`notchedCausality_separates`, `notchedCausality_dual_separates`): causal plainness gives no causal openness, global or local, in either orientation and in either reading of `defi:causalite`; 2026-11-21 |
kb_proposals: pattern — A causality on a closed subspace of ℝ²: the notched plane. Carrier the subtype M = {u ≤ 0 ∨ v ≤ 0}, a closed down-set of the product order, so a future causal segment ENDING in M lies in M (segment_subset_Icc); a step is `a ≤ b ∧ segment ℝ a b ⊆ Subtype.val '' U`. For thickening arguments take the ambient open O with val⁻¹' O = U (isOpen_induced_iff), move the segment in O by Causal.eventually_segment_subset_of_isOpen, and come back with the down-set property (notchedPlane_segment_subset_image); points near a subtype point come from mem_nhds_subtype, and a small ε > 0 from (h.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds).and self_mem_nhdsWithin |>.exists. Curves into the subtype: the affine path with the parameter clamped, max 0 (min r 1) (notchedPath) (T-abs-plain-not-open).

pattern — Push-up on a polygonal causality from the openness of I±_U alone: for x ≪ y ≤ z, induct on the causal chain; I⁺_U(x) is open, so it contains y − (ε, ε), from which a causal step y → z is chronal. For x ≤ y ≪ z, head-induct; I⁻_U(z) is open and contains y + (ε, ε) when there is room (here from y's first chronal step), at which the step x → y is chronal. No tilted chain with decreasing εᵢ is needed (Causal.notchedCausality_pushUp).

pattern — Causal plainness of a model whose future chronology fails on a thin set: apply Causality.causallyPlain_of_locZ to C.dual (LocZplus of C.dual is C's chronal past neighbours, LocZminus of C.dual off S is C's chronal future neighbours off S), then dual_causallyPlain; S needs only empty interior (Causal.notchedCausality_causallyPlain, S = the notch's edge).

pattern — The notched plane: an either-reading witness that causal plainness gives no causal openness. Absolutely minimal on every open set, plain, push-up, GH, strongly causal, a time function, causally open in the future; not causally open in the past, nor locally at the corner, no chronal neighbours, not tarentin; its time reversal fails future openness, global and local (Causal.notchedCausality_separates, notchedCausality_dual_separates). The ladder forces such a model to be push-up (absolutely_minimal ∧ causally_plain ⇒ push_up, T1) and without chronal neighbours (push_up ∧ chronal_neighbours ⇒ causally_open): both hold (T-abs-plain-not-open).
